newsitem.title: UK: Colombia $750 mln 10-yr global bond due next week.
newsitem.headline: Colombia $750 mln 10-yr global bond due next week.

text.p: Colombia will launch a $750 million 10-year global bond next week following a series of investor presentations, an official at joint lead manager J.P. Morgan said on Monday.
"Colombia will start roadshows on Wednesday and the deal is expected in the middle of next week," the official said.
Merrill Lynch is the other joint lead manager.
Last week Colombia filed a shelf registration with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $750 million in bonds due February 2007.
The proceeds would be used for general budgetary purposes, the filing said.
Colombia launched a $400 million five-year Eurobond last May at 150 basis points over U.S. Treasury notes.
